quickAnswer.question: Can Claude transcribe audio?
quickAnswer.answer: Yes, with TranscriptX. Add TranscriptX to Claude as a custom connector, upload an audio file or paste a link, and ask Claude to transcribe it. TranscriptX turns the speech into text and returns the full transcript to the chat, where Claude can summarize, translate or answer questions about it. Setup takes about a minute — see the Transcription MCP guide.

sections.h2: How Claude Transcribes Audio With TranscriptX
content: Claude is excellent at reading and working with text, but it is not built to listen to audio files on its own. TranscriptX fills that gap.

Once TranscriptX is connected, the work is split in two. TranscriptX listens to the recording and turns the speech into text. Claude receives that transcript and does what it does best — summarizing, translating, analyzing and rewriting.
You stay in one chat the whole time: upload the file, ask for a transcript, and continue with your next question.

sections.h2: Why Use TranscriptX to Transcribe Audio in Claude

items.content: Recordings Claude cannot open on its own become text it can read, quote and analyze.
The transcript lands directly in the conversation instead of being moved between tools.
Meetings, lectures and podcast episodes are transcribed in full and read in parts, so Claude works with the whole recording.
Transcribe in the language that was spoken, then ask Claude to translate it.
TranscriptX only receives the file or link you ask it to transcribe. Uploaded files are deleted within 12 hours.
